# How much of our electric bill is one bad 15 minutes, and what would it take to remove it?

> Free tool for businesses with demand charges: paste 15-minute utility interval data and see monthly peaks, demand charges, ratchet effects, and what shaving the peak would save and need. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/demand-charge-interval-analyzer/)
